sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance for Q2 was lowered to a low-single-digit comparable sales decline and EPS of $1.30-$1.70, below the Q1 EPS of $2.05, and management explicitly flagged a worsening trend in shrink that will reduce profitability by more than $500 million year-over-year. Full-year guidance was maintained but with cautious language about softening sales trends and elevated macro uncertainty, indicating a negative forward outlook.

summary.revenue: Total revenue of $25.3 billion grew 0.6% compared with last year, reflecting total sales growth of 0.5% and a 10.2% increase in other revenue.
summary.eps: First quarter GAAP EPS of $2.05, down 4.8% from $2.16 in 2022. First quarter Adjusted EPS of $2.05 decreased 6.2% compared with $2.19 in 2022.
summary.guidance: For Q2 2023, GAAP and Adjusted EPS expected to range from $1.30 to $1.70, with comparable sales centered around a low-single digit decline. For full-year 2023, maintaining prior guidance: comparable sales in a wide range from a low-single digit decline to a low-single digit increase, operating income growth of more than $1 billion, and GAAP and Adjusted EPS of $7.75 to $8.75.
summary.margin: First quarter gross margin rate was 26.3%, compared with 25.7% in 2022. Operating income margin rate was 5.2% in 2023, compared with 5.3% in 2022.
key_risks: Inventory shrink is expected to reduce full-year profitability by more than $500 million compared with last year, driven by theft and organized retail crime.
Softening sales trends in discretionary categories, with further softening in March and April.
Persistent inflation and rising interest rates pressuring consumer spending.
Higher SG&A expense rate due to cost inflation and investments in team member pay and benefits.
key_opportunities: Strength in frequency businesses (Beauty, Food & Beverage, Household Essentials) offsetting discretionary softness.
Continued traffic growth for 12 consecutive quarters, indicating guest trust and loyalty.
Efficiency and cost-saving efforts expected to benefit the P&L in the second half of the year.
Strategic inventory investments in frequency categories and long-term market share opportunities.
Growth in same-day services like Drive-Up, with high-single digit growth.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management repeatedly used cautious language, e.g., 'we are planning for a wide range of sales outcomes in the second quarter, centered around a low-single digit decline' and 'we remain cautious on the overall environment in light of the macro industry pressures we've outlined today.'
